long_biography.plain_text:
Subirats began building his enterprise in Tortosa in 1975, creating SB Immobiliària for residential development and construction. The company expanded from the Ebro region to Tarragona and Barcelona, ultimately delivering thousands of homes. Thirteen years later he diversified into hotels, developing a chain of urban properties under the SB Hotels name.

Restaurant ventures including El Nacional Barcelona and LomoAlto broadened the portfolio, while the businesses were unified as Subirats Bureau. The group expanded across hotels, property development and gastronomy. In 2025, Subirats moved from chairman to honorary president and remained a director as Gerard Subirats Gonfaus became chairman.
